messages:
alex: heads up — deploy-bot just finished shifting 20% -> 50% traffic to embeddings-service v2 for the gamma release. seeing a p95 bump on embeddings-route.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: service=embeddings-service version=v2 traffic=50% commit=ab12cde

maria: can you paste the p95 numbers?

alex: p95 at 300ms -> 520ms over last 6m, p99 from 720ms -> 1.1s. error rate still flat ~0.02% so not spikes in 5xx.

sre_lead: interesting — tail latency up without errors. could be kv-cache miss behavior with v2 quantization. any correlation with sequence length?

jordan: looking at traces — a bunch of long tails on requests with seq_len > 1024. v2 seems to run slower on longer contexts there.

ops_tess: do we have a canary pin or fallback route? we should consider pinning v1 for high-latency traffic classes.

alex: release_mgr flagged this as non-critical but wants to keep close watch. suggestion: route high-length requests to v1 and keep lower lengths on v2.

maria: quick config check: we can add a routing rule by header X-Seq-Len and route >=1024 -> v1. easy to roll out via routing service.

sre_lead: agree. plan: add header rule, watch p95 for overall and for >=1024 group. if overall p95 stays elevated after rule, revert to 100% v1.

jordan: I can push the routing rule now. pushing a dry-run first to simulate.

deploy-bot: routing-change scheduled: routing-service rule add if header X-Seq-Len >= 1024 -> backend embeddings-service:v1 (dry-run)

alex: dry-run looks OK, no errors in validation. Jordan — flip to active when ready.

jordan: flipping to active now.

deploy-bot: routing-change executed: rule active id=rt-2026-03-21-01

maria: watching dashboard — overall p95 down from 520ms -> 360ms within 3 minutes after rule. p95 for >=1024 bucket down to 400ms.

sre_lead: good signal. maintain for 15m. set an alert if p95 for low-length bucket (seq <1024) rises >20% from baseline.

release_mgr: action item — capture root cause with ML team: does quantization fallback or kv-cache sharding cause the regression for long contexts? please add to release notes under known issues.

ops_tess: created jira INF-3245 and added links to traces and dashboards.

alex: should we avoid a rollback then? traffic rule effectively pins problematic class to v1; no rollback for full version.

sre_lead: agree — no global rollback. keep the routing pin and run extended soak. prepare rollback playbook if p95 returns and errors increase.

maria: I'll annotate the deploy-bot thread with the routing change and ticket.

jordan: leaving monitoring on high cadence (1m) for next 30m. I'll also enable extra traces for seq_len >= 1024.

deploy-bot: reminder: canary window ends in 45m. roll metrics snapshot will be generated at 1758812000.

release_mgr: thanks everyone. summary: introduced routing pin for long-context requests to v1, metrics improving, no rollback. follow-up: root-cause investigation (INF-3245) and update release notes. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — will follow up if anything flares.
